name: WhatsApp Business Cloud API
tagline: Order updates on WhatsApp with approved templates, a two-way inbox and SMS fallback.

screens.title: Reply to customers in Botble
screens.caption: Inbound WhatsApp messages land in a simple inbox. Reply with free text while the 24-hour window is open.

screens.title: Know what was delivered and read
screens.caption: Every message with Meta's sent, delivered and read receipts. Failures show the reason and the SMS fallback.

screens.title: Map notifications to approved templates
screens.caption: Sync your templates from Meta, map each order notification and see at a glance if it is approved and matching.

screens.title: Connect the Cloud API
screens.caption: Phone number ID, access token and app secret (stored encrypted), webhook URL and verify token, and SMS fallback.
